title: Blueprint Fundamentals
body: What the Glean Blueprint Consultation is, why it exists, its three steps, and the outcomes it produces for customers, partners, and Glean
kicker: 6 lessons · knowledge check at the end of this page
list_label: By the end of this module you can:
list: Define the Blueprint Consultation and its purpose.
Name the three steps and the default validation path.
Explain why Blueprint replaces open-ended AI experimentation.
Distinguish the Sales Blueprint from post-sales SA blueprints.
footnote: Recommended before this module: Glean Foundations (FND-101/102/103); Sales Accreditation (SAL-103). Prerequisites are proposed; roadmap mappings are alignment only, not equivalency.
